mandatory_technical_themes.title: Public physical backup/restore can bypass binding and overwrite a sidecar

mandatory_technical_themes.title: ConsistencyAnalyzer opens SQLite and graph data outside normalized admission
mandatory_technical_themes.scope: Declare store-only admitted analysis or explicitly offline historical inspection. Use one normalized vector/graph layout; no alternative-root probing after refusal. Preserve analysis algorithms.

mandatory_technical_themes.title: Legacy synthesis can omit vectors and invoke an implicit Chroma embedder
mandatory_technical_themes.scope: Require failure when the selected embedder is absent or refuses; never omit embeddings to let a collection select a hidden model. Classify public legacy helpers and module read/dry-run entries without enabling disabled mutations.
mandatory_technical_themes.proof: Missing/failed embedder yields zero collection writes/default embedding work; guarded public and module entry dispositions are explicit and negative witnesses preserve current disabled CLI mutation behavior.

mandatory_technical_themes.title: Consolidation can acknowledge source turns after summary-storage refusal
mandatory_technical_themes.scope: Explicitly cover the public-unwired consolidator, separately from ordinary extraction/compaction. Permit only guard-error propagation and successful-batch acknowledgement changes; retain scheduling, prompts and record semantics.
mandatory_technical_themes.proof: Overflow, mismatch and invalid-vector storage failures leave affected turns retryable and produce no success event/acknowledgement; mixed-batch and retry positives work under baseline and replacement configurations.

mandatory_technical_themes.title: Lifecycle counts and tool text can report failed mutations as success
mandatory_technical_themes.scope: Count completed non-dry-run mutations truthfully and expose failures in public tool execution text; preserve dry-run prospective counts, partial-results policy and lifecycle thresholds/order.
mandatory_technical_themes.proof: Same-space success and overflow/identity/invalid-vector failures verify both structured results and ordinary tool execute text; refused mutations are not counted as successes.
